item.seals.sealing_scroll.tooltip: Right-click a weakened mob to seal it inside you
message.seals.already_sealed: You already carry %s sealed inside you
message.seals.too_strong: %s is too strong: bring its health down to %s%% or less
message.seals.sealed_hint: Press U to see the bond and Alt for combat mode
message.seals.seal_broken: The seal broke! %s has been freed
message.seals.ability_passive: %s is passive: it is always active
screen.seals.title: Bond
screen.seals.combat_hint: Press %s to enter combat mode and use keys 1-9
ability.seals.manto_ferruquimico.desc: Your skin is covered in shiny grey iron. You gain a lot of armor and nothing can knock you back. Press its key to put it on or take it off.
ability.seals.pies_de_hierro.desc: When you fall from great heights, your feet turn to metal as you land and you take no damage.
ability.seals.yo_soy_el_golem.desc: You become a bigger creature while keeping your skin. You gain armor and your bare-handed punches hit much harder and launch enemies into the air. Can be combined with the Ferrous Mantle.
ability.seals.holy_golem.desc: Summon the blue spirit of a golem that fights by your side. It is faster than a normal golem, can jump and attacks whoever attacks you. Press again to dismiss it.
info.seals.bond.title: About the bond
info.seals.bond.hint: Hover over the stars, affinity, stability or age to see how they work. Press Talk once a day; with 1 ★ you can Enter its inner world every 4 days.
info.seals.stars.title: Affection level
info.seals.stars: Every time affinity reaches 100, affection goes up a level and you earn a star. This mob has %s stars (max level %s).
info.seals.affinity.title: Affinity
info.seals.affinity: Goes from 0 to 100 and rises with small actions the sealed mob likes. At 100 you earn a star. Every year the mob ages gives +70.
info.seals.stability.title: Seal stability
info.seals.stability: Starts at 100. Doing things the mob hates lowers it. At 0 the seal breaks and the mob is freed to attack you.
info.seals.age.title: Age
info.seals.age: When sealed it was between %s and %s years old. Each Minecraft day is a month and every 12 days a year. Each year increases damage, duration of transformations and effects, and the health of its summons.
info.seals.age.bonus: At %s years old, its abilities have +%s%% power.
seal.seals.iron_golem.bond: You carry the spirit of an Iron Golem, guardian of villages. It is strong and loyal, but it cannot stand harm being done to its own.
seal.seals.iron_golem.affinity: The golem likes: trading with villagers (+1), killing hostile mobs (+1), defeating a boss (+50) and you using its abilities (+1 every minute).
seal.seals.iron_golem.stability: The golem is angered by: killing villagers (-10), players (-20) or allies such as your pets, iron golems or teammates (-5). If the seal breaks, a furious golem with double health comes out.
message.seals.oldest_one: %s is the first in the world whose %s reaches 800 years. They are now the %s
info.seals.age.months: It is %s years and %s months old. Its abilities have +%s%% power.
command.seals.oldest_one.none: Nobody has claimed the hidden rank yet
command.seals.oldest_one.reset: The hidden rank is free again
message.seals.oldest_one.inherited: %s inherits the title of %s after %s lost their sealed mob
message.seals.oldest_one.lost: %s has lost their sealed mob. The title of %s is free for the next one to reach 800 years
screen.seals.tip.talk: You already talked today. Come back tomorrow
screen.seals.tip.days: You can enter again in %s days
screen.seals.tip.inside: You are already inside the bond
info.seals.talk.hint: Talking once a day gives +10 affinity.
message.seals.talk.wait: You already talked today. Come back tomorrow
message.seals.inner.unavailable: The inner world cannot be opened
message.seals.inner.enter: You enter the seal. %s awaits behind the door
message.seals.inner.door_open: The door opens... get close and right-click to talk
message.seals.inner.wait: You cannot enter again yet (%s days)
message.seals.bond.start: Your bond grows stronger! Full boost for %s minutes
message.seals.release: You and %s leave the seal in peace. It is free now
message.seals.mini.dismissed: The mini golem returns inside you
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.0: Today I counted the villagers of the last village. All of them were there. Good.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.1: Have you seen any poppies? I like holding them.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.2: I sense zombies before you do. Relax, I'm keeping watch.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.3: I was made from four iron blocks and a pumpkin. Still, here I am.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.4: I don't like rain. I rust... on the inside.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.5: Village kids stare at me and I give them flowers. I don't know why I do it.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.6: If you see a creeper near a house, tell me. You know what I think of them.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.7: My steps are slow, but I've never been late to a fight.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.8: An iron ingot suits me better than any food.
seal.seals.iron_golem.talk.9: Protecting is what I know. Now I protect you.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.greet.0: You came. Everything is quiet in here... I like it.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.greet.1: I was waiting for you, guardian.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.greet.2: Welcome to my corner. No villages to guard, but I still stand.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.greet.3: I hear your steps on the water from afar. What do you want?
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.yes.0: Strong as always. Thanks for asking.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.yes.1: Good. No rust and no cracks.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.yes.2: Calm. With you near, I have nothing to fear.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.no.0: ...I don't feel like talking right now.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.how.no.1: Leave me. My arms feel heavy today.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.yes.0: I feel useful. It's been a long time since I felt like this.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.yes.1: Safe. Like when a village sleeps peacefully.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.yes.2: I feel that you trust me. And I trust you.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.no.0: Locked up. Sometimes I miss the sun.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.feel.no.1: I don't know. Golems don't usually think about that.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.food.ask: Food? I don't eat... but an iron ingot mends my cracks. That's the closest thing.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.food.none: You don't carry any iron ingots. It's alright.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.food.thanks: An ingot! I can feel my cracks closing. Thank you, friend.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.fight.start: You want to test your strength? Very well. Don't hold back!
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.fight.win: Good hit. You're stronger than I thought.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.fight.lose: Enough. I don't want to really hurt you. Come back when you're ready.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.bond.yes: Take my strength. For a while, we will be one.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.bond.wait: I haven't regained strength for that yet. Come back in %s days.
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.break.ask: You want to break the seal? I would go out into the world with you... and we would go separate ways. Are you sure?
seal.seals.iron_golem.inner.break.done: Thank you for everything. I will always protect your village.
command.seals.cooldowns: Cooldowns reset for %s (talk, enter, BOUND and abilities)
message.seals.wolf.not_yours: You can only seal a wolf that is yours
message.seals.wolf.wait: Your wolf doesn't trust you enough yet (%s days left)
ability.seals.instinto_primal.desc: You awaken the wolf's instinct: you run faster, sense every nearby creature (they glow even through walls) and see their name above their head. Your eyes glow red and leave a small trail.
ability.seals.hombre_lobo.desc: You turn into a werewolf: your body and skin change, claws come out, you gain armor and become stronger and faster. Bare-handed swipes tear.
seal.seals.wolf.bond: You carry the spirit of your wolf. It is loyal to the death and will always protect you, but it never forgives harm done to the pack.
seal.seals.wolf.affinity: The wolf likes: hunting (sheep, rabbits, foxes, chickens and skeletons, +1), killing hostile mobs (+1), you eating meat (+1), defeating a boss (+50) and you using its abilities (+1 every minute).
seal.seals.wolf.stability: Your wolf never gets angry with you, whatever you do: its seal cannot be broken by force. It can only be broken in peace from its inner world, and it will be your wolf again.
seal.seals.wolf.talk.0: *Sniffs your hand and wags its tail*
seal.seals.wolf.talk.1: I smell a skeleton nearby. Shall we go after it?
seal.seals.wolf.talk.2: The moon is almost full. I feel it in my bones.
seal.seals.wolf.talk.3: You are my pack. That never changes.
seal.seals.wolf.talk.5: Sheep run when they see me. I don't know why.
seal.seals.wolf.talk.6: *Howls softly* Sorry, it just came out.
seal.seals.wolf.talk.7: I don't like water, but I'd get wet for you.
seal.seals.wolf.talk.8: If someone attacks you, they'd better be ready.
seal.seals.wolf.talk.9: I like sleeping at your feet. You can do that in here too.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.greet.0: *Raises its ears and wags its tail when it sees you*
seal.seals.wolf.inner.greet.1: You came! I smelled you from the door.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.greet.2: Everything in here smells like you. I like it.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.how.yes.1: Good, full belly and the pack is safe.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.how.yes.2: Happy. I'm always happy when you come.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.how.no.1: Grrr... I'm not in the mood today.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.feel.yes.0: Strong. Like I could run all night.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.feel.yes.2: Free, even in here. Weird, right?
seal.seals.wolf.inner.feel.no.0: I miss running through the forest.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.feel.no.1: *Whines* I don't know... my collar itches.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.food.ask: Meat! A good raw steak, uncooked. That's the best thing in the world.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.food.none: *Sniffs your pockets* No steak... oh well.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.food.thanks: *Devours it in a second* THANK YOU! You're the best!
seal.seals.wolf.inner.bond.yes: Run with me. For a while, we are one pack.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.bond.wait: I'm still tired. Come back in %s days.
seal.seals.wolf.inner.break.ask: You want to let me out? I'd be your usual wolf again, by your side. Are you sure?
command.seals.stability_locked: %s's seal cannot be broken by force
item.seals.abyssal_trident.tooltip: Loyalty and riptide, even out of water
message.seals.elder.how: The Elder Guardian is not sealed like this: let it defeat you while holding the scroll in your off hand
message.seals.elder.sealed: You fall... but you don't die. The elder of the sea now lives inside you
message.seals.elder.wet: You feel the sea again. The Elder Guardian calms down
message.seals.elder.dry_start: Yesterday you didn't spend 5 minutes underwater. The Elder Guardian begins to dry out...
message.seals.elder.drying: The Elder Guardian is drying out! Get into the water
message.seals.elder.no_target: There is nothing to fire the beam at
message.seals.elder.trident: The Elder Guardian hands you the Abyssal Trident
message.seals.elder.trident_have: You already have the Abyssal Trident
message.seals.elder.trident_gone: The Abyssal Trident dissolves into sea foam
ability.seals.hijo_del_mar.desc: You breathe underwater, swim faster and no sea creature attacks you. But the Elder Guardian needs water: spend at least 5 minutes a day submerged or it will start drying out.
ability.seals.rayo_abisal.desc: Lock your gaze on an enemy and charge a beam for 2 seconds, like the guardian does. If you don't lose sight of the target, the beam hits hard.
ability.seals.piel_profunda.desc: The Elder Guardian has grown used to you: you can spend days out of water without it drying out.
ability.seals.forma_abisal.desc: You are covered in the elder's scales and grow spikes and a tail. You gain resistance and a lot of armor (even more in water), move faster and whoever hits you takes part of the damage.
ability.seals.tridente_abisal.desc: A trident made from the Elder Guardian itself. It deals heavy damage and always has loyalty and riptide, even out of water. If you lose it, press its key to get it back.
dialog.seals.option.give_key: Hand over a Heart of the Sea
seal.seals.elder_guardian.bond: You carry the elder of the sea, guardian of the sunken monuments. It is proud and dislikes dry land: it won't always answer you.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.affinity: The Elder Guardian likes: you being underwater (+1 every 2 minutes), talking to it when it answers (+10), defeating a boss (+50) and you using its abilities (+1 every minute).
seal.seals.elder_guardian.stability: It is angered by: killing land creatures (-2) and spending a day without 5 minutes underwater (it dries out and slowly loses stability). It recovers by being underwater or killing sea creatures.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.0: The currents are changing. Something big moves in the deep.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.1: I guarded a temple for centuries. Now I guard you.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.2: Dry air cracks my scales. Take me to the water.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.3: The drowned are not my people, but they respect my voice.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.4: My eye has seen ships sink that nobody remembers anymore.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.5: Sponges grow where I swim. It's a good sign.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.7: Don't trust the silence of the sea. It is never empty.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.8: You defeated me when I defeated you. A curious pact.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.9: A Heart of the Sea beats stronger than any treasure.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.ignore.0: *The eye looks at you for a moment and closes*
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.ignore.1: *Only the distant murmur of waves can be heard*
seal.seals.elder_guardian.talk.ignore.2: *A shiver runs down your spine. It doesn't answer*
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.greet.0: You have reached me. Few manage that.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.greet.1: *The great eye slowly opens* Speak, little one.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.greet.2: The water of this place is yours. And still, it belongs to me.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.greet.3: I am listening. Make it brief.
Serene. Like the bottom of the ocean.
Better than I expected to be inside a human.
Good. Thank you for taking me to the water.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.how.no.1: That is none of your business.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.feel.yes: Ancient. But with you, less alone.
Powerful. Your body is a fine monument.
At peace. I hadn't been for centuries.
Trapped. I miss my prismarine halls.
*A deep hum fills the room. No answer*
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.food.ask: Tropical fish. They shine like the corals of my temple.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.food.non: You don't carry any tropical fish. Another time.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.food.tha: *The eye glows* It tastes like the reef. Thank you.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.door.loc: This door does not open for just anyone. Bring me a Heart of the Sea and prove your worth.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.door.nok: You don't carry a Heart of the Sea. Come back when you have one.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.door.acc: It beats with the strength of the ocean... You are worthy. Come in.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.break.as: You want to free me? I would return to the ocean and you would never see me again. Are you sure?
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.break.do: Thank you, little one. The sea will remember your name.
seal.seals.elder_guardian.inner.bye: Come back when the water calls you.
message.seals.cat.not_yours: You can only seal a cat that is yours
message.seals.cat.wait: Your cat doesn't trust you enough yet (%s days left)
message.seals.cat.gift: When you wake up you find a gift from your cat at your feet
ability.seals.ojos_felinos.desc: You see in the dark (night vision) and nearby enemies are highlighted, even through walls, with their name above their head. Your eyes glow green.
ability.seals.siete_vidas.desc: Like every cat, you always land on your feet: you never take fall damage.
ability.seals.forma_felina.desc: You turn into a black cat. You are much faster, jump much higher, fit through one-block gaps and can climb walls up to 5 blocks by walking into them. A cat doesn't carry anything in its paws.
seal.seals.cat.bond: You carry the spirit of your cat. It does its own thing and doesn't always listen, but it never leaves you. Creepers are afraid of it, and of you too.
seal.seals.cat.affinity: The cat likes: hunting (rabbits, chickens and phantoms, +1), killing hostile mobs (+1), you eating fish (+1), leaving you a gift when you wake up (+2), defeating a boss (+50) and you using its abilities (+1 every minute).
seal.seals.cat.stability: Your cat never gets angry with you, whatever you do: its seal cannot be broken by force. It can only be broken in peace from its inner world, and it will be your cat again.
seal.seals.cat.talk.1: I saw a phantom. Don't worry, it ran away.
seal.seals.cat.talk.2: Is that salmon I smell? Tell me it's salmon.
seal.seals.cat.talk.3: Tonight I'll bring you a gift. Don't ask where I get it.
seal.seals.cat.talk.4: Creepers are afraid of me. I like that.
seal.seals.cat.talk.5: I fell asleep on your bed. It's mine now.
seal.seals.cat.talk.6: *Stares at you without blinking for a long time*
seal.seals.cat.talk.7: Landing on your feet is easy. Caring is the hard part.
seal.seals.cat.talk.8: I see in the dark better than you. Much better.
seal.seals.cat.talk.9: I chose you. Don't ruin it.
seal.seals.cat.inner.greet.2: Meow. This place is mine, but you can stay a while.
seal.seals.cat.inner.greet.3: *Purrs loudly* I was waiting for you. Don't tell anyone.
seal.seals.cat.inner.how.yes.2: Calm. There are no dogs in here.
seal.seals.cat.inner.how.no.1: Not now. I'm busy staring at nothing.
seal.seals.cat.inner.feel.yes.0: Agile. Like I could jump to the moon.
seal.seals.cat.inner.feel.yes.1: Loved. Though I won't admit it out there.
seal.seals.cat.inner.feel.yes.2: Warm. Your insides are like a sunny spot.
seal.seals.cat.inner.feel.no.0: Bored. There's nothing to knock off the table here.
seal.seals.cat.inner.feel.no.1: *Hisses softly* I don't want to talk about it.
seal.seals.cat.inner.food.ask: Raw cod. Fresh, from the river. No cooked fish.
seal.seals.cat.inner.food.none: *Sniffs your hands* You don't smell like cod. Disappointing.
seal.seals.cat.inner.food.thanks: *Eats it in two bites and purrs* Fine, I forgive you for everything.
seal.seals.cat.inner.bond.yes: Move your paws with me. For a while, we'll hunt together.
seal.seals.cat.inner.bond.wait: I'm sleepy. Come back in %s days.
seal.seals.cat.inner.break.ask: You want to let me out? I'd be your usual cat again, at home. Are you sure?
seal.seals.cat.inner.break.done: *Meows and jumps into your arms* Let's go home.
